settings.title: Settings
settings.deleteAccountConfirmBody: This permanently deletes your account and everything in it — wardrobe, outfits, friends, messages. This can't be undone.
settings.deleteAccountError: Couldn't delete your account. Please try again.
settings.personalFormalityHint: So AURA never suggests a blazer to someone who hates them, even when "technically correct".
settings.styleBoldness: How much do you like to experiment?
settings.styleBoldnessHint: For occasions that aren't strictly formal (weekend, work depending on your job, casual dinners) — AURA will lean toward this instead of asking each time. It doesn't apply where the occasion itself calls for something classic, like a black-tie event.
settings.workDaysHint: Used when generating a week of work outfits at once.
settings.workDaysNote: An evening event outside these hours won't stop AURA from also planning your work outfit for that day.
settings.notificationsIntro: AURA only sends in-app notifications — no push alerts outside the app. Choose which ones you want to see.
settings.notifOutfitShareSub: When a friend shares an outfit with you in chat
settings.notifWeatherChangeSub: When the forecast changes for a day you've already planned an outfit
settings.sharedLibraryLabel: Share my wardrobe in the common library
settings.sharedLibraryDesc: Your pieces (brand, price, tags, photo) become searchable by other members, anonymously — nobody can see they are yours. Turning it off removes them from future searches, but pieces others already imported stay in their own closet.
